component.name: Frametop Installer
component.summary: Install Frametop on your Steam Frame without a terminal

description.p: Frametop turns a Steam Frame into a multi-screen desktop. This installer downloads the newest stable or experimental release of Frametop from GitHub, asks which optional parts to install, asks for your SteamOS password once if a part needs it (or helps you set one), and shows the install's progress.

It isn't sandboxed in any meaningful way: Frametop installs user services, a SteamVR driver and containers, and some parts need sudo, so the installer runs the install on the headset's host system through flatpak-spawn. Frametop is an independent project, not made by or affiliated with Valve.
